product.name: Rivet Mid-Century Luxe Velvet Dining Chair, 34.1"H, Set of 2, Dark Green
product.description: These mid-century casual dining chairs in dark green offer a touch of glam with easy-care luxe velvet upholstery and a Hollywood regency flavor. Rounded edges on the seat and back along with golden powder-coated legs accent this simple design that comes as a set of 2. 21"W x 21.5"D x 41"H Easy-care fabric on wood frame with metal legs Soft, rounded edges on the seat and back These casual dining chairs with a mid-century look offer a touch of glam with luxe velvet upholstery that rests on golden powder-coated legs. Simple assembly in 15-30 minutes Vacuum or wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
